plugin.name: LittleSkin sign-in
plugin.description: Let users sign in to this site with LittleSkin or link their existing account.

clientId.label: Client ID
clientId.help: Create an OAuth app on LittleSkin at https://littleskin.cn/user/oauth/manage, then enter its client ID here. The callback URL is shown on this page; copy it exactly into the app’s settings.

clientSecret.label: Client secret
clientSecret.help: The app’s client secret. It is not shown again after saving.
